title: Phone focus mode: full-screen walk-through view beside the message view

requirements.text: The main screen has two modes, switchable from the top bar: Messages (today's chat, unchanged) and Focus; the choice survives an app restart
requirements.check: eye: toggle on the Pixel, kill and reopen app, same mode

requirements.text: Focus keeps the same text/mic input bar at the bottom, so TJ can say or type anything at any time
requirements.check: eye: send a new message from Focus on the Pixel

requirements.text: Focus shows the current item full screen under a header naming its project, with an agenda of the walk's item titles marking which is being read, which are heard, and which are open questions
requirements.check: eye: 3-item walk on the Pixel shows header + agenda with the current one marked

requirements.text: Open questions are styled distinctly and the full explanation sits in its own scrolling area
requirements.check: eye: question item on the Pixel shows a styled question block and a scrollable body

requirements.text: The app builds and the existing JVM tests still pass

evidence: testDebugUnitTest 7/7 (WalkPlanTest), assembleRelease + assembleDebug ok with Studio JBR; shipped 0.1.454336 (16596939 bytes, checked online) to R2 link

text: Built Focus.kt (header, agenda, question block, scrolling full reply, walk controls), toggle in top bar saved as pref 'focus', WalkBar hidden in Focus. Link.walked tracks heard items. Shipped 0.1.454336 to R2. Waiting on TJ's on-phone look for reqs 1-4. Not committed.
Wi-Fi install to Pixel failed (adb No route to host, ping+port ok, adb restart did not help from this session). 0.1.454336 is on the R2 link for TJ to install. Waiting on his look for reqs 1-4.
0.1.454336 installed on the Pixel over Wi-Fi (adb install Success, versionName checked). Waiting on TJ's look for reqs 1-4.

TJ on the Pixel: Focus never appeared (it was an undiscoverable toggle), he saw the old WalkBar under the input, unstyled, and could not stop speech. Redoing: walk always takes the area above the input, Spotify-like now-playing styling, big pause, live caption at bottom.

v2 on Pixel (0.1.454364-ish, installed + screenshotted): Spotify-style digest above input, project colour gradient, segmented progress, big headline (first sentence when untagged), one-line NEXT, big play/pause, karaoke caption with body only. Walk auto-switches to digest. TJ found v1 unreadable (4 competing text blocks); v2 fixes hierarchy. Awaiting his look. Not committed.

Installed on Pixel: title is context (project/task, or REPLY/Tally untagged), caption reveals only words already spoken, Status update is icon-only with connection dot badge. Live-play caption not yet seen (phone locked). Not committed.

Items now carry re (TJ's last message before the reply) and at (reply time), persisted; digest shows a YOU SAID quote under the title. 7 tests pass, installed on Pixel. Old queued items have no re. Not committed.

Committing phone app + bridge digest code together (Voice.swift Tally instruction left to session e89284fb, which holds it). Reqs 1-4 await TJ's day of use on the Pixel; reqs 5 proved. Open follow-up: bridge should send the exact prompt a reply answers (phone guesses last message).
